updates.title: Safety Zone; Pasquotank River Harbor, Elizabeth City, NC
updates.summary: The Coast Guard is establishing a temporary safety zone for certain navigable waters on the Pasquotank River, at Elizabeth City, NC. The safety zone is needed to protect personnel, vessels, and the marine environment from potential hazards associated with an over-the- water drone display. updates.title: Restructuring the Governance and Funding Model of the Consolidated Audit Trail
updates.summary: Although the consolidated audit trail (the "CAT") continues to be a necessary regulatory tool, its decentralized governance has presented certain challenges to administering the CAT. updates.title: Amendment of Class D Airspace and Class E Airspace Over Tri-Cities, TN
updates.summary: This action amends Class D and Class E airspace over Tri- Cities, TN. Specifically, this action modifies the Tri-Cities Class D and Class E surface area airspace by expanding the radius and lateral boundaries to the northeast and removing the Tri-Cities Class E surface area extension airspace to the northeast. updates.title: Renewal of Department of Defense Federal Advisory Committees-Defense Health Board
updates.summary: The DoD (referred to herein as "the Department of War" or "DoW") is publishing this notice to announce it is renewing the Defense Health Board ("the DHB") as a discretionary Federal advisory committee.

updates.title: Renewal of Department of Defense Federal Advisory Committees-Department of Defense Wage Committee
updates.summary: The DoD is publishing this notice to announce it is renewing the Department of Defense Wage Committee ("the DoD Wage Committee") as a discretionary Federal advisory committee.

updates.title: Hydrofluorocarbon Blends From the People's Republic of China: Final Results of Antidumping Duty Administrative Review; 2024-2025
updates.summary: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) determines that producers/exporters subject to this review made sales of subject merchandise at less than normal value during the period of review (POR) August 1, 2024, through July 31, 2025.

updates.title: Light-Walled Rectangular Pipe and Tube From the People's Republic of China: Final Results of Countervailing Duty Administrative Review; 2024
updates.summary: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) determines that countervailable subsidies were not provided to Hangzhou Ailong Metal Products Co., Ltd. (Hangzhou Ailong), a producer and exporter of light- walled rectangular pipe and tube (LWR pipe and tube) from People's Republic of China (China). The period of review (POR) is January 1, 2024, through December 31, 2024.

updates.title: Records Schedules; Availability and Request for Comments
updates.summary: The National Archives and Records Administration (NARA) publishes notice of certain Federal agency requests for records disposition authority (records schedules). We publish notice in the Federal Register and on regulations.gov for records schedules in which agencies propose to dispose of records they no longer need to conduct agency business. We invite public comments on such records schedules.
